basic_info.description: Prime Location!! Spacious one bedroom, one bath condominium located in a classic 29-unit San Francisco elevator building. This sunny, South-facing corner unit has period details and hardwood floors throughout, two large walk-in closets, a recently remodeled bathroom, and an updated kitchen which features a gas range with microwave above and new countertops. The breathtaking shared roof deck has 360 views of the GG Bridge, Alcatraz, Coit Tower and downtown. Just a short walk to Moscone Park, Fort Mason, Marina Green, and a block from the amenities and public transportation on Union Street. Filled with SF charm. Deeded parking in the building included--it really has it all! Walk Score 98, Walker's Paradise
